_about: Every QTT OS app screen the assistant may point to. id = what the app opens; product = null for the app itself. roles: '*' = anyone with that app; product roles by name; '@owner' = business owner/admin; '@manager' = has people reporting to them. tips: shown on that screen (and used by the assistant); 'when' names a condition in qtt_platform.assistant.conditions.

screens.title: Home
screens.what: Your apps, the For you cards (what needs you now) and search across everything.

screens.title: Search
screens.what: One search for customers, people, items and apps. Understands typos, any word order and phone numbers.

screens.title: Customers
screens.what: One customer list shared by every app (Onbox chats, Orbitra bills). Add, tag, archive; call, WhatsApp or email a customer.

screens.title: Add customer
screens.what: Add an individual or a business (GSTIN, billing address, tags).

screens.title: Business profile
screens.what: Logo, address, GSTIN, contact details, bank and UPI — used on invoices, payslips and PDFs. Only the owner or an admin can change them.

screens.title: Team
screens.what: Invite teammates by email, choose which apps each person can use and their role in each app, remove people.

screens.title: Plans
screens.what: Each app's plan and trial end date. To upgrade or change a plan, contact Queen Touch Technology.

screens.title: Account
screens.what: Your accounts (switch between several), appearance, language, tips, help and support, fingerprint / Face ID sign-in, sign out.

screens.title: Appearance
screens.what: Light, dark or system mode, theme, text size and density.

screens.title: Office Pulse
screens.what: Check in / out, today's team (managers, HR), your tiles: attendance, leave, expenses, payslips.

screens.title: My attendance
screens.what: Your month calendar: in / out times, hours, late days. Request Work From Home or On Duty for past or coming days (a manager or HR approves).

tips.text: Working from home or out on work? Request Work From Home or On Duty here — your manager approves it.
tips.label: Request work from home

screens.title: Leave
screens.what: Your leave balances, apply for leave (half days allowed; holidays not counted), your requests; withdraw open or future ones.

tips.text: Working from home instead of taking leave? Ask for Work From Home — it doesn't use your leave balance.
tips.label: Request work from home

tips.text: Your business allows checking in away from the office: just add a reason when you check in.
tips.label: Check in

screens.title: Expenses
screens.what: Your expense claims and their status; new claim with several expenses and receipt photos; withdraw a pending claim.

tips.text: Add a photo of each receipt — claims with receipts are approved faster.
tips.label: New expense claim

screens.title: New expense claim
screens.path: Office Pulse › Expenses › New expense claim
screens.what: One claim: what for, amount and date per expense, details, receipt photos (up to 5 MB each).

screens.title: Payslips
screens.what: Your payslips, newest first: earnings, deductions, net pay; download the PDF. They appear after HR runs and finalises payroll.

screens.title: Team today
screens.what: Who is in, out, on leave or not in yet today (remote check-ins are marked).

screens.title: Approvals
screens.what: Leave, attendance (WFH / on duty) and expense requests from your team: approve or reject with a note.

screens.title: People
screens.what: Employees (working / left): add, edit, give app access (email invitation), mark attendance, salary, mark as left.

screens.title: Setup
screens.what: Check-in rules (ask for location; allow check-in away from the office), offices and their check-in radius, leave types and giving leave, holiday calendars, shifts (late after minutes, auto attendance), departments and job titles.

tips.text: Turn on “Allow check-in away from the office” so people can work from home and check in with a reason.
tips.label: Open Setup

screens.title: Payroll
screens.what: Steps: 1) a salary template with pay items (formulas allowed, e.g. base * 0.4), 2) give it to people with their monthly salary, 3) run payroll for a month, check, then finalise and publish payslips.

screens.title: Orbitra
screens.what: Today's sales, money to collect, items running low, and your tiles.

screens.title: POS
screens.what: Quick counter sale: tap items (search or barcode), choose a customer or walk-in, take payment (cash, UPI, card, or split; change is worked out), save the bill PDF.

screens.title: Sales
screens.what: Invoices (unpaid first) and quotes: new invoice, new quote, receive a payment, save or share the PDF, take back items (credit note), turn a quote into an invoice.

tips.text: Send prices first with a quote; turn it into an invoice when they agree.
tips.label: New invoice

screens.title: New invoice
screens.what: Bill a customer: items, GST, total, paid now or later.

screens.title: Inventory
screens.what: Items and services: price, cost, GST rate, HSN/SAC, barcode, low-stock level; add stock, count stock, move between stores; running-low list.

tips.text: Set “Tell me when stock is at or below” on an item and Orbitra warns you before it runs out.
tips.label: Open Inventory

screens.title: Purchases
screens.what: Supplier bills (stock comes in), what you still owe, suppliers, pay a supplier. Needs a plan with Purchases.

screens.title: Orbitra customers
screens.what: Who owes you and what they bought; new invoice or receive payment for a customer.

screens.title: Accounts
screens.what: Money in and out, record shop expenses (rent, electricity…), move money between cash and bank, who owes you and whom you owe. Needs a plan with Accounts.

screens.title: Reports
screens.what: For a period: sales by day, best sellers, best customers, GST (collected minus paid on purchases), profit, stock value. Needs a plan with Reports.

screens.title: Orbitra settings
screens.what: Selling prices include GST (on/off), main store, invoice note, run setup again. Business details on invoices come from Business › Profile.

screens.title: Onbox
screens.what: All your channels with open and unread counts; tap one to see its conversations.

screens.title: Conversations
screens.what: Customer chats from WhatsApp, website chat, Facebook, Instagram and email: Mine / Unassigned / All, filter by status and channel, reply or add private notes, assign, snooze, label, resolve, save the contact as a customer. WhatsApp replies are free-form only within 24 hours of the customer's last message.

screens.title: Onbox settings
screens.what: Channels: connect WhatsApp (Meta Cloud API), website chat (paste the code on your site), Facebook, Instagram, email (forwarding or mailbox); rename or remove. Channel access: choose which team members answer each channel (managers and supervisors see all).

screens.title: Managed Services
screens.what: Everything QTT runs for you: status of your websites and systems, your services, previews to approve, connecting your domain to go live, recent activity.

screens.title: All services
screens.what: Every service QTT offers with its price; suggestions for your kind of business; start a free one instantly or pay to start (the owner orders).

screens.title: Requests
screens.what: Ask QTT for a change or help; mark it urgent if something is broken; QTT replies there.

screens.title: Payments
screens.what: Your invoices for services and paying them (UPI, card or net banking).
